title: Tokyo-Style Skillet Beef Teriyaki
description: A flavorful and savory dish inspired by the streets of Tokyo, featuring tender beef and a sweet teriyaki sauce.
instructions: 1. Preheat your skillet over medium-high heat.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together teriyaki sauce, red wine vinegar, brown sugar, ginger, garlic, and soy sauce.
3. Add the skirt steak to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
4. Remove the steak from the skillet and let it rest.
5. Reduce heat to medium and add the whisked sauce to the skillet.
6. Simmer the sauce for 2-3 minutes, or until it thickens slightly.
7. Slice the steak against the grain and serve with the teriyaki sauce spooned over the top.
8. Garnish with sesame seeds and chopped green onions, if desired.
